build_preemption_decider_process: build a PreemptionDeciderProcess to decide when to preempt GPU-worker stragglers during VER+DD-PPO training
run_compute_time: run _compute_time to calculate the optimal rollout time and max possible steps for experience collection
update_rollout_steps: update the PreemptionDeciderProcess to gather step averages across workers and compute optimal rollout steps
start_rollout_worker: start a rollout by sending a start_rollout task with the current perf_counter timestamp to the decider queue
end_rollout_worker: end a rollout by sending an end_rollout task with the current timestamp and number of next steps
